reviews.text:
I’m actually really impressed with this cushion! The coverage is buildable and gives me a really smooth, even base without looking heavy or cakey. It has that nice “my skin but better” finish while still covering redness and small imperfections.

What I especially like is how thin and comfortable it feels on the skin. It doesn’t feel like I’m wearing a full face of foundation, and the finish is really pretty and skin-like. It also layers nicely where I need more coverage without getting patchy.

I have combination, acne-prone skin and so far it’s been really nice on my skin. The shade also worked really well for me. Definitely one of the cushions I’ve been reaching for the most lately!

I just wish they sold refills.
reviews.zh:
我真係好欣賞呢款氣墊！遮瑕力可以逐層疊加，塗開之後底妝好順滑、均勻，唔會厚重或者厚粉，亦唔會斑駁。質感有「似自己皮膚但更好」嘅感覺，仲可以遮到紅位同細小瑕疵。

我特別鍾意佢嘅薄身同塗落去嘅舒適感。唔會覺得似係成面粉底咁，妝感又靚又似皮膚本身。需要加強遮瑕嘅位置，疊多次都唔會斑駁。

我嘅皮膚係混合性、易生暗瘡，用咗之後都好好，色號都好啱我。最近真係成日都揀呢款氣墊！

我淨係希望佢哋可以賣補充裝。

reviews.text: I bought this in shade 23 after using the shade match tiktok filter for this cushion, which looked like a perfect match but in reality is a bit light. If you used the tiktok filter keep that in mind. Cushion has a point which helps to reach all areas, and the pact itself has a cover with texture to take off excess product from the puff. Overall, the finish is very nice, coverage is decent, and it stays on pretty well.
reviews.zh: 我用咗呢款氣墊嘅 TikTok 色號配對濾鏡之後，買咗 23 號色。濾鏡入面睇落好似完美啱色，但實際上有少少偏淺。如果你都係用 TikTok 濾鏡，要留意呢點。氣墊有一個尖位，可以塗到各個位置；粉盒個蓋有紋理，可以刮走粉撲上多餘嘅產品。整體嚟講，妝感好靚，遮瑕力幾好，仲可以持妝得幾好。

reviews.text: i have very pale skin that turns yellow and i bought shade 17 but that shade looks pink on my skin so next time i would get another shade. but this cushion is very nice and hydrating. i have dry skin and my other foundation after 8 hours of wear would start to flake off and seprate. i did not have that problem with this cushion. after wearing it for 8 hours my skin still looked like when i first applied it very dewy and hydrated. the only sepration was on my left smile line bc i didnt set it properly, my right one was smooth no line or sepration and thats the place where my foundation would break up first. i will be bying this cushion again just different shade.
reviews.zh: 我嘅皮膚好白，而且容易泛黃。我買咗 17 號色，但係個色塗喺我皮膚上面偏粉紅，所以下次我會揀另一個色號。不過呢款氣墊好好，好滋潤。我嘅皮膚乾，之前用嘅其他粉底穿咗八個鐘之後會起皮同埋分界。用呢款氣墊就冇呢個問題。穿咗八個鐘之後，我嘅皮膚仲係好似剛塗嗰陣咁，好水潤、好滋潤。唯一分界嘅位置係我左邊嘅笑紋，因為我冇好好定妝；右邊就順滑、冇紋、冇分界，而右邊正正係我其他粉底最先裂開嘅位置。我會再買呢款氣墊，但係會揀另一個色號。

reviews.text:
The 2aN Gleaming Tension Pact is an absolute dream for anyone looking to achieve that classic, luminous K-beauty "glass skin" finish. The first thing that catches your eye is the stunning, glitter-embellished compact—it looks incredibly luxurious and is a joy to pull out of your bag for touch-ups.
Inside, the cushion features a fine tension mesh that dispenses the perfect, even amount of product onto the puff every single time. The formula itself is wonderfully lightweight and hydrating, gliding onto the skin effortlessly to smooth over texture and even out tone with a breathable, medium buildable coverage. It feels incredibly comfortable throughout the day, providing a gorgeous, dewy radiance that looks lit-from-within rather than greasy. With six shades available to help find a great match, it's a fantastic, high-performing choice for a flawless, glowing complexion on the go!
reviews.zh:
2aN Gleaming Tension Pact 絕對係想達到經典、透亮嘅韓式「玻璃肌」效果人士嘅夢幻之選。第一眼最吸引人嘅係個閃閃發光、飾有閃粉嘅粉盒，好奢華，放喺袋入面補妝嗰陣拎出嚟，都係一件令人開心嘅事。
裏面嘅氣墊有幼密嘅張力網，每次都可以推出啱啱好、均勻嘅份量到粉撲上。配方本身好輕盈、補水，塗喺皮膚上好順滑，可以撫平紋理、均勻膚色，質感透氣，中等遮瑕力，並且可以逐層疊加。成日都穿得好舒服，帶嚟一種水潤嘅光澤，睇落好似由內而外發光，但唔會油膩。有六個色號，可以幫你搵到啱嘅顏色，係一個好出色、表現好好嘅選擇，令你隨時隨地都有無瑕、閃亮嘅膚色！

reviews.text: I somehow managed to get my perfect shade on the first time and I'm so happy! The product is light weight with quite light coverage too. It is smooth and not cakey if applied correctly and the finish is glowy. I recommend if you want a comfortable foundation that is easy to apply! For the coverage, I think it can be layered for more coverage but it would be too hard for my beginner skills. It works like a blurring filter.
reviews.zh: 第一次就意外咁揀中咗啱自己嘅色號，好開心！產品好輕盈，遮瑕力都幾淡。如果塗得啱，就會好順滑、唔會厚粉，妝感好有光澤。如果你想要一款穿得舒服、易塗嘅粉底，我推薦！至於遮瑕力，我覺得可以疊加遮到多啲，但係以我嘅初學者手勁嚟講就太難。佢效果好似柔焦濾鏡咁。

reviews.text: Lasts all day but some powders can make it pill. I lightly set it with Dasique soft cotton powder and I don’t have to worry about it melting off. Gives a pretty glow that isn’t too much. I got shade 29 and it’s a bit too dark for me when I build up the coverage but works well enough as I’m getting more tan with this sunny weather. I use Nyx bare with me concealer in shade 7 medium and unleashia green cushion in shade 27 as my “normal” shades.
reviews.zh: 可以持妝成日，但係有啲蜜粉會令佢起搓。我用 Dasique soft cotton 蜜粉輕輕定咗妝，就唔使擔心會溶走。妝感有種好靚嘅光澤，但係唔會太誇張。我揀咗 29 號，疊加遮瑕之後會有少少深，但係因為呢排天氣好曬，我愈嚟愈曬黑，所以都夠用。我日常用嘅色號係 Nyx bare with me 遮瑕膏 7 號 medium，同埋 unleashia 綠色氣墊 27 號。

reviews.text:
This is the best cushion I’ve ever had—OMG! I have oily, acne-prone skin, and it doesn’t make my skin worse at all. It sits beautifully on my face, and my red spots completely disappear when I use it. Even with my oily skin, it holds up so well. I genuinely love it—it’s the first time I’ve fallen this hard for a cushion. If you have oily skin, seriously, give it a try! 
AND The lightest shade is really pale. It does match my skin perfectly, but I kind of look sick with it on. Maybe going one shade darker next time wouldn’t be a bad idea 😭 It’s my first time ever saying that—usually foundations are always too dark or too yellow for me. But this one is perfect, especially for my girls with a pink to neutral undertone! I think the darker shades also don’t lean yellow, which is amazing. You’re gonna love it!
reviews.zh:
呢個係我用過最好嘅氣墊——OMG！我皮膚油、易生暗瘡，但係用咗佢，皮膚完全冇變差。佢貼面好靚好服貼，我用咗之後，紅色痘痘完全消失。即使我皮膚油，佢都撐得住。我真係好鍾意——呢個係我第一次咁死心塌地咁鍾意一款氣墊。如果你皮膚油，真係要試吓！
另外，最淺嗰個色號真係好淺。佢啱我嘅膚色，不過塗咗之後，我有啲似病咁。下次可能揀深一號都唔錯 😭 呢個係我第一次講咁嘅說話——平時粉底對我嚟講，唔係太深就係太黃。但係呢款好完美，尤其係適合我嘅女仔姊妹哋，如果底色偏粉紅至中性！我覺得深啲嘅色號都唔會偏黃，真係好正！你一定會好鍾意！

reviews.text:
I haven't tried many cushion foundations and decided to try this one as there was a promo for an eyeshadow palette with a certain spend on the brand. I love the packaging, though it does look a bit fancier in the photos here than in person.
I chose #22 Medium as that was the only colour in stock and I thought with summer coming up I would be too pale to go for the lightest colour.

I am slightly too pale still, as it's not summer yet, but I tan really easily if I don't wear sunscreen which I don't on my body so my arms are already tanned. The Medium shade blends in quite nicely and when on my face doesn't look odd with the rest of my body so I'm glad I chose this shade. 

The formula itself is nice. I have issues with foundations either caking and/or highlighting texture and lines/wrinkles but this one isn't drying or cakey. It doesn't blur texture completely but it doesn't make it appear worse.

So far so good, but will update once summer hits and I give it a decent test during the heat.
reviews.zh:
我未試過好多氣墊粉底，所以決定試吓呢款，因為品牌有促銷活動，消費到指定金額就送眼影盤。我好鍾意包裝，不過相入面睇落，好似比實物華麗少少。
我揀咗 #22 Medium，因為得呢個色有貨。我諗住夏天就快到，我會太白，所以唔揀最淺嗰個色。

我依家仲係稍為太白，因為未到夏天，但係我如果唔擦防曬，就好易曬黑；我身體冇擦防曬，所以手臂已經曬咗。Medium 色號同皮膚融合得幾好，塗喺面上同身體其他位置都唔會有突兀感，所以我好高興揀咗呢個色。

產品本身幾好。以前用粉底，我經常有問題，會厚粉或者突顯紋理同細紋／皺紋，但呢款唔會乾、唔會厚粉。唔會完全遮蓋紋理，但都唔會令紋理睇起嚟更差。

到目前為止都好好，但係等夏天到咗、熱嘅時候我好好試一試之後，會再更新。

note: 以下評價由 YesStyle 顧客撰寫，OUJI 原文引用、只加中文翻譯，冇改動內容，亦冇刪走負評。只顯示我哋有貨嘅色號，同價錢有關嘅評價唔會收錄（兩邊售價唔同）。
